title: feat(app-shell): Connect an Agent asks which AI client you use and shows only its steps
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-tesla"} -->
_Requested by **Tesla** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01AXsQkLFKRdQCqQ3RTr6Jao?thread=cmsg_01AXsQkLFKRdQCqQ3RTr6Jao4R5vgzn4JR1Ewtt4rWD5cr)_

Fixes #30896

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：「连接智能体」页不再一次铺开七张卡片。端点与 SKILL.md 下载仍在最上方；其下先问「你用的是哪个 AI 助手？」（Claude、Codex、Cursor、WorkBuddy、豆包工作、千问办公），只显示所选那一个的步骤，切换一次点击，本浏览器记住选择；API 密钥表单移到底部折叠的「高级：脚本与 CI」。
- 为什么改：一个人只用一个客户端，原来要翻过另外六个客户端的说明才找到自己的步骤，API 密钥卡还混在客户端中间。实测页面主体从 1604 px 降到 664 px 高。
- 风险与回滚：只动这一个页面组件和新增的三条文案；选择存在本地浏览器（`os:pref:connect.client`），读不到时回到 Claude。密钥签发逻辑原样未改。回滚即 revert 本 PR。
- 先看：`ui/packages/app-shell/src/console/connect/ConnectAgentWidget.tsx`（Tabs 与 Collapsible 两处）、`connectClientPreference.ts`、测试文件末尾新增的 describe。
- 两分钟验证：打开 设置 → Connect an Agent，点「Codex」，刷新页面仍停在 Codex；点「高级：脚本与 CI」才出现 API 密钥表单。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地。
- **席位意见**：ui 席 2 对照 head `953cfc49` 的 diff 复核：14 个文件、+448 / −207，无受治理路径。各客户端步骤、片段与提示文字原样搬进 `Tabs`，只渲染所选一个；选择经控制台既有的偏好存储（`user` 范围，`os:pref:connect.client`）保存，读不到或已不提供的客户端回到 Claude；API 密钥卡整体移入默认折叠的「高级：脚本与 CI」，签发与确认逻辑未改，签发结果状态在父组件，折叠不会丢失。席位核对时更正了 changeset 里新增文案的条数（三条），此外无改动。CI 全绿，Clause-② no，不欠契约复审。同意落地。

## What changes

- `ConnectAgentWidget.tsx`: under the endpoint card (URL, copy, SKILL.md download — unchanged, on top for everyone), a card asks "Which AI assistant do you use?" and holds a `Tabs` picker from `@object-ui/components` with the six clients in the order the page offered them. Only the chosen client's steps render; every client's steps, snippets and hints are the same text as before. The API key card moves into a `Collapsible` "Advanced: scripts and CI" at the bottom, closed by default; its mint/confirm logic is unchanged.
- `connectClientPreference.ts` (new): the client ids and the reader's choice, declared through the console's one preference store (`utils/workspacePreference.ts`, imported, not edited), `user` scope, stored as `{"client":"CLIENT_ID","v":1}` under `os:pref:connect.client`. A stored id the page no longer offers, an unreadable record, or storage that throws reads as no choice → Claude. The store already wraps every storage access in try/catch.
- i18n: three new keys (`connectAgent.client.title`, `connectAgent.client.hint`, `connectAgent.advanced.title`) in all ten console packs. PR #30902 is not on `main`, so they sit in today's `zh.ts` / `pt.ts`.
- Root changeset `.changeset/30896-connect-agent-client-picker.md` (`@object-ui/app-shell`, `@object-ui/i18n`: patch).

## Tests

`ConnectAgentWidget.keyName-13355.test.tsx` (the component's one harness file):
- the three key-name cases open the Advanced section first, then assert as before;
- the Chinese-clients block now walks the picker: tab order, each client's body + hint on pick, each client's transport spelling;
- new top-level describe: endpoint + SKILL.md on top, Claude only with no choice, key form collapsed until opened; one click switches and the choice is stored and read back after remount; an unknown stored client reads as Claude.

## Acceptance notes

- With no stored choice the picker opens on Claude rather than on an empty state; the card asks the question in the card heading and shows the first client's steps.
- The Chinese clients' hints still say "(create a key below)"; the key form is below, now behind the Advanced trigger. #30898 rewrites this copy.
- No widget heading follows the #30895 rename: the widget has none, the page title is metadata.
- Three `no-explicit-any` lint warnings in the file are pre-existing lines that moved.

## Verification

Head `6111073f` (my commit `181fd4df` + merge of `origin/main` `33043bd8`, no overlap with this diff).

<details><summary>Live measure on a local deployment (showcase with the fresh flag, console Vite dev), admin and member</summary>

Widget body height at a 1004 px wide pane:
- before (`main` 0e882086 source): admin 1604 px, member 1604 px. Endpoint card, the Claude card, then Codex, Cursor, WorkBuddy, Doubao Work, QwenWork and the API key card, all open.
- after: admin 664 px, member 664 px. Endpoint card, the picker card showing Claude's steps, the closed "Advanced: scripts and CI" trigger.
- member click-through: pick Codex → Codex steps shown, `claude mcp add` gone, `localStorage['os:pref:connect.client']` = `{"client":"codex","v":1}`; reload → Codex still selected; API key name input absent until Advanced is opened, present after.
</details>

<details><summary>Local tests and gates</summary>

- `pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run packages/app-shell/src/console/connect/` → 9/9 passed (on 181fd4df and again on 6111073f)
- `pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run packages/i18n/` → 97 files, 1521 passed, 13 skipped
- `pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run packages/app-shell/src/__tests__/product-neutral-renderer.ratchet.test.ts` → 32/32
- `pnpm --filter @object-ui/i18n run type-check && pnpm --filter @object-ui/app-shell run type-check` → exit 0
- eslint on the three changed widget files → 0 errors; `pnpm check:new-line-citations` → 0 new
- `dispatch-gates --commands` derived 36 commands on 181fd4df; all 36 exit 0 (incl. `node scripts/check-sdui-manifest.mjs`, `pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run scripts/` 170 files passed); `--ran` reconciliation: 36 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED, 0 UNRUN.
</details>
